6 minutes from the Amina Resort, where you can feel the taste of Vietnamese tradition!
Oct 2024 • Family
While staying at Amina Resort, I discovered a Vietnamese local restaurant called Quan Ngon Đó just 6 minutes away! As a Korean tourist, I wanted to experience the local food properly, and this place perfectly met those expectations.

First we ordered bananas, full of fresh shrimp and pork in a spicy Vietnamese pancakes. It reminded me of Korea's history, but Vietnam's special charm was added! Afterwards, Poor's was eating beef rice, which was impressive with its deep, aromatic taste. Herbs and spices combined, and a mouthpiece was impressed.

The atmosphere at the restaurant was comfortable and cozy, and it was a more enjoyable experience for the staff to introduce the recommended menu. The price is reasonable, so it is perfect for enjoying local food while travelling. If you’re in Amiaana or visiting nearby, you’ll be sure to taste the Vietnamese tradition at Quan Ngon Đó!
